finding.action.showDetails.comment: Native button in the collapsed preview findings band. Expands the typed findings inside the same preview, with internal scrolling. It does not open a window or read the source again. Translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.

finding.action.hideDetails.comment: Native button in the expanded preview findings band. Collapses details and returns their space to preview content. Counterpart of Show details. Translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.
